description: This file defines a scraper function for extracting recipe data from 'budgetbytes.com' web pages. It uses 'request' to fetch HTML content and 'cheerio' to parse and extract specific recipe details such as ingredients, instructions, and timing information. The function returns a Promise that resolves with a Recipe object or rejects with an error.

classes.name: RecipeSchema
classes.description: A schema object for storing recipe details, imported from a helper module.

methods.name: budgetBytes
methods.description: Main function that takes a URL, fetches the webpage, and extracts recipe data if the URL belongs to 'budgetbytes.com'.
